'''Norith Z'all''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You're going to find my daughter? Good. Maybe you can be the man my husband isn't.|Norith Z'all, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FC" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Norith Z'all lived on Corellia with her husband [[Zorgom Z'all|Zorgom]] and her daughter [[Neeka Z'all|Neeka]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> At some point, Norith and his family were captured by [[Faye Patrick]] who sold them to the [[Corellian slavers]].<ref name="SWG:TtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Bandor|Corellia}}</ref> The Z'all family was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Zorgom and Norith managed to escape the bunker, along with a group of slaves led by [[Kyran Silene]]. Unfortunately, they lost their child in the escape and Neeka was catch up. The escaped slaved did not reach Tyrena and established a camp in the wilderness.<ref name="SWG:FC" /> A spacer recruited by Kyran Silene's [[Madison Silene|wife]] later arrived at the camp.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> The spacer planed to infiltrate the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Incriminating Evidence|Corellia}}</ref> The spacer also met Zorgom and Norith Z'all and agreed to rescue their daughter while going to the bunker. With the help of the slave [[Gordo Zek]], the spacer was able to find Neeka Z'all and helped her to escape the bunker. The child later returned to her parents.<ref name="SWG:FC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Norith Z'all was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:FC" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Norith Z'all was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
